description: This file defines a ToolRegistry class responsible for managing collections of tools, organizing them by categories and subcategories, and providing methods for registration, retrieval, toggling, and clearing tools within the registry.

classes.name: ToolRegistry
classes.description: A class to manage a registry of tools, including registration, retrieval, enabling/disabling, and clearing tools.

methods.name: None register_tool( self, *, category: str, subcategory: str, tool_name: str, tool: OpenAPITool )
methods.description: Registers a new tool under specified category and subcategory, adding it to the internal dictionaries.

methods.name: Mapping[str,Mapping[str,Mapping[str,OpenAPITool]]] get_categories(self)
methods.description: Returns an immutable view of all categories and their tools.

methods.name: dict[str,OpenAPITool] get_category_tools( self, category: str, subcategory: str | None = None )
methods.description: Retrieves tools within a specified category, optionally filtered by subcategory.

methods.name: OpenAPITool|None get_tool(self, tool_name: str)
methods.description: Fetches a tool by its name.

methods.name: dict[str,dict[str,OpenAPITool]]|None get_category_subcategories( self, category: str )
methods.description: Returns all subcategories for a given category.

methods.name: ToggleResult toggle_tools(self, tool_names: list[str], enable: bool)
methods.description: Enables or disables a list of tools, returning a status message.

methods.name: None clear(self)
methods.description: Clears all registered tools from the registry.

ctags.name: get_categories
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_categories(self) -> Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Mapping[str, OpenAPITool]]]:$/

ctags.name: get_category_tools
ctags.signature: ( self, category: str, subcategory: str | None = None )

ctags.name: get_tool
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_tool(self, tool_name: str) -> OpenAPITool | None:$/

ctags.signature: ( self, *, category: str, subcategory: str, tool_name: str, tool: OpenAPITool )

ctags.pattern: /^    def toggle_tools(self, tool_names: list[str], enable: bool) -> ToggleResult:$/
